stories.title: Define Tool Scope Enforcement Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the contract for tool scope enforcement including allowed tool registry, request-derived scope (per turn/session), and validation rules for tool invocation. Ensure compatibility with existing Pydantic tool_models and allowlist dispatch patterns.

stories.title: Implement Server-Side Scope Enforcement in Tool Router
stories.description: Extend tool_router to enforce scope boundaries at runtime by validating each tool call against the allowlist and request-specific scope. Reject or block any tool invocation outside permitted scope before execution.

stories.title: Integrate Scope Enforcement with FastAPI Tool Execution Loop
stories.description: Ensure scope enforcement is applied at the tool invocation boundary within the FastAPI request lifecycle and Claude tool-use loop in main.py, including consistent pre-dispatch validation and user-safe error handling on violations.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Scope Enforcement
stories.description: Create tests validating that allowed tools execute successfully and out-of-scope tools are rejected. Include edge cases such as malformed tool calls and bypass attempts. Extend existing test_tool_router coverage.

stories.title: Standardize Scope Violation Error Contract and Logging
stories.description: Define and implement a consistent error response contract for scope violations, including error codes, messages, and safe user-facing text. Integrate with debug_logger to record violations with metadata (tool name, request scope, rejection reason) for audit and debugging.
